purpose: Guarded stock optolink-splitter permanent-VS1 smoke gate using the existing Home Assistant read poll list before enabling any production GFA polling.

prerequisite_live_result.conclusion: F7 Virtual_READ and 6B GFA_READ coexist in one persistent VS1 session on the exact VDensHO1/20C2 appliance at tested 150-ms pacing.

helper.local_logic_tests: 10/10 embedded tests; v1.0.1 adds Git-blob hash helper test

write_ingress.mqtt_commands_and_set_topics: disabled by mqtt_listen=None; upstream on_message returns before command/set handling

stock_verification.preferred: clean Git checkout with HEAD == origin/main and no tracked modifications

fallback_for_migrated_installation.behavior: If .git is absent, all 14 pinned runtime Python files must match exact upstream Git blob IDs before any service/settings change.

process: MainPID remains stable for complete window
journal contains no configured timeout/poll/restart error patterns
mqtt: subscriber is connected before temporary splitter start
all current homeassistant_poll_list entries enabled on poll cycle 0 must publish at least once
missing topics are listed and cause FAIL
recovery: SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP cleanup handlers are armed before service/settings changes
original settings SHA256 is verified byte-for-byte before service restoration
splitter and party service are restored only if previously running
restored splitter must return active/running and log VS2/300 protocol initialized
backup is removed only after verified byte-exact restore; otherwise retained locally

not_validated_by_pass: catastrophic interruption recovery such as SIGKILL/power/storage failure
next_after_pass: Implement a narrow update-safe structured GFA_READ path under the splitter's single VS1 serial owner, then stage P06/P09/P87/P80 diagnostic polling.

first_attempt.reason: /opt/optolink is not a Git working tree; git rev-parse HEAD exited 128
first_attempt.note: Failure occurred before backup creation, service stop, MQTT subscriber start, or temporary settings write.
